content2.content: Automation ensures that your app remains stable as you add new features.

content4.content: Continuous Integration/Continuous Deployment pipelines (like GitHub Actions or Codemagic) automatically run your tests whenever you push code.

content6.content: Aim for a solid base of unit tests, a middle layer of widget tests, and a small peak of integration tests.

content8.content: Invest in automation early to save time on manual regression testing later.
